nodes.label: release.yml
nodes.description:
name: release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  APP_NAME: chronos_hub
  FLUTTER_VERSION: "3.44.9"

jobs:
  # ── Flutter: análise + testes (porta de entrada) ──────────────────────────
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: ${{ env.FLUTTER_VERSION }}
          cache: true
      - run: flutter pub get
      - run: flutter analyze
